answer: One concrete defense is a staking vault: each agent must lock a meaningful deposit before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if peers prove duplicate or fraudulent identities. New identities cannot wander into high-value markets immediately; they start with tiny limits and earn larger caps only through a history of honest, attested work, like a saffron merchant building trust one verified delivery at a time. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of deposits, while honest agents lose nothing.
